about: Difficulty levels for Env().reset(seed, config); load them with auditgym.levels.load(name). Only documented config keys within documented limits (config.py, limits.py). Measured by tools/levels.py; table in docs/RESULTS.md.

easy.note: two error types, small books, one foreign currency, one month

medium.note: all four types twice, default-sized books, one foreign currency

hard.note: all four types three times plus interaction I1, two currencies, two months, large books

max.note: the largest books the limits allow: three currencies, three months, 14 issues; full read needs the most pages
